$comment: Consumed by scripts/ci/check_docs_truth.py. Every allowlist entry carries a reason: an allowlist without reasons is where findings go to be forgotten.

reference_allowlist.docs/architecture/freeze/W1A_CORE.sha256: exists; listed so a future rename is noticed here first
reference_allowlist.scripts/ci/release-surface.txt: prose reference to the NFTBan equivalent, not this repository's file

w1a_corpus.$why: The certified corpus. A document that quotes a different value contradicts the artifact it certifies.

external_projects.$why: C-06 forbids competitive framing ABOUT ANOTHER PROJECT. Framing words alone are not the offence: 'declared vs resolved' and 'state vs observation' are ordinary technical distinctions, and a policy document that QUOTES the prohibition must not trip it. A finding requires a named external project on the same line.
